cuts.reason: Cuts from the wide two-shot of the bedroom (subtitle 'with') straight into a tight close-up on the husband's scowling face (subtitle 'will'), punching in right as his line escalates for emphasis.

Cuts back out from the husband's close-up to the wide two-shot (subtitle 'Ask') to bring the wife's reaction back into frame as the exchange continues, resetting the geography for the next beat of dialogue.
Hard cut from the live-action-style bedroom scene straight to the black title/outro card ('LOW BATTERY PEOPLE / CREATED BY NIN.'), ending the skit abruptly right after the punchline exchange.

reaction_shots.description: Tight close-up on the husband's annoyed, wide-eyed face as he snaps back mid-argument, isolating his reaction rather than showing both characters.

pacing_notes: The two dialogue shots are nearly identical in length (~4.4s and ~4.3s), giving the argument a steady, even rhythm rather than accelerating cuts. The final shot is much shorter (~1.1s), an abrupt jump straight to the black title/outro card immediately after the punchline line, giving the piece a clipped, sudden stop rather than a wind-down.
